target_normalization: For monomial row (r,s,i,j), multiply (E*c)[row] by p^r*q^s*psi_i*psi_j. Here psi=(a,b,t,1). This is the entire scalar target (1+pU)(1+qV)*chi^T P_c(pU,qV;diag(psi)) chi.
solution: h_free=z; h_pivot=pivot_rhs_map*b[independent_rows]+pivot_free_map*z. Require b=full_target_compatibility_map*b[independent_rows] and all four symmetric H blocks PSD.
restore: G_g=p^(-alpha_g)*q^(-beta_g)*D_g^(-1)*S_g^T*H_g*S_g*D_g^(-1), with D_g=diag(p^r*q^s*psi_i) on the original features and S_g=[I|-1].
reflection_verified: Full generic parent congruence, four kernel residuals, both angular residuals, and normalized state involution; no seed-only inference.
